biggest_catch: TranscribeMe's own site states $15-$22 per audio hour, but publishes no concrete payout schedule in official materials.
catches: Pay is per AUDIO hour, not per working hour - an audio hour typically takes several hours of active typing work.
No official concrete payout timing found on TranscribeMe's official pages or FAQ index.
You must pass the English entrance exam before earning; the qualification exam is unpaid.
Work availability is first-come-first-served - no guaranteed volume.
Work is reviewed by QA; rejected clips earn nothing.
